leakCoverage.reason: A fixture leak is a deterministic data→render property; the same build artifact renders the same content in every viewport. Running 95 detail routes × 5 projects would multiply runtime ~5x without adding information beyond browser-specific rendering differences (already covered by the other interaction tests on all 5 projects).

ATLAS-READABILITY.status: mechanism completed + proven by assertion (browser confirmation still pending)
ATLAS-READABILITY.change: Added validator assertions QA-ATLAS-mandated-visible / -canary / -deterministic. At default zoom all 8 order-mandated labels are now in the rendered data-label-visible set: 中途岛、夏威夷、菲律宾、新加坡、马来亚、关岛、威克岛、澳大利亚北部 (14 labels visible / 46 nodes, 0 overlapping pairs).
ATLAS-READABILITY.rootCauseFixed: resolveMandatedPlaceIds was order-dependent (first substring match won, so 夏威夷 bound to place-pearl-harbor or place-oahu depending on array order, and 中途岛 bound to place-us-tf-area). Now scored by field (name vs country) with a deterministic short-name tiebreak — verified identical across content / sorted / reversed orders.
ATLAS-READABILITY.canary: QA-ATLAS-mandated-canary demotes one mandated label and requires the judgement to report exactly 1 hidden; separately I verified demoting ANY of the 8 individually would fail the assertion.

ATLAS-zoom-tiers.detail: Collision still binds before the 18/26/40 budget tiers: measured 14 / 15 / 15 labels at zoom 1 / 1.5 / 2, then all 46 at zoom >= 3. The tiers remain effectively dead. Reported as a limitation rather than claimed fixed.

estimateLabelWidth-fallback.detail: The `: 100` width fallback in QA-ATLAS-no-overlap was replaced with an explicit fail() so the check can never silently degrade to a constant again.

skippedAccounting.explanation: 95 exhaustive detail-route leak tests x 4 non-desktop projects = 380. Remaining ~6 come from the desktop side of the first-item sampling split and one conditional hidden-label skip. This matches the intended gating; it is not accidental over-skipping.

attempt4Findings.(1) timeline-deep-link: FIXED in source: TimelineView resolved dateIndex only in a useState initialiser, which never re-runs because the view is not remounted on hash change. Extracted to useCallback(resolveDateIndex) + useEffect syncing on initialDate. SSR: date=1942-01-11 -> data-timeline-date-count=14 (content truth 14/19); no date -> 19. Browser test navigates while mounted and computes the expectation from content/history.json.
attempt4Findings.(2) questions-empty: FIXED in tests+source: root cause was test timing, not view logic — AppShell renders .pw-nav while content is still status=loading, so the test asserted before data arrived. main.tsx now exposes [data-content-status] and openRoute waits until it leaves "loading".
attempt4Findings.(3) a11y: FIXED in source: --pw-brass-text #8a5a14 -> #7d4f0c (4.35:1 -> 5.16:1 on --pw-paper-2, 6.12:1 on --pw-paper); brand link aria-label now contains the visible title (label-content-name-mismatch).
attempt4Findings.(4) map-label-overlap: PARTIALLY PROVEN: estimateLabelWidth was optimistic (CJK assumed 1.0em, no letter-spacing) which is why SSR said 0 pairs while Chromium measured 17. Now conservative (CJK 1.15em, Latin 0.62em, +6 padding) and the browser test measures real getBoundingClientRect boxes per place. SSR after fix: 12 visible labels, 0 geometric overlaps, all 8 mandated labels still visible.
attempt4Findings.(5) map-keyboard: FIXED in source: data-map-transform / data-map-tx / data-map-ty / data-can-pan were entirely absent, so a browser test could not observe pan. Added to the canvas. Note: at zoom=1 clamping is maxTx=0, so ArrowRight correctly moves nothing; the test now zooms first and asserts data-can-pan flips false->true.
attempt4Findings.(6) media-visible: MITIGATED: first figure per gallery now loading="eager" so a below-the-fold lazy image cannot stall a naturalWidth>0 assertion. Render path unchanged (figure/img/alt/credit all verified in SSR).
attempt4Findings.(7) reader-copy: EXTENDED: added a browser-level recheck over 9 reader pages plus map legend/phase copy and evidence-panel labels, using the same JARGON list as the SSR check.

attempt5Fixes.RangeError (root cause): tests/learning.spec.ts requireBattle() called ITSELF instead of searching realContent.battles — infinite recursion, `Maximum call stack size exceeded`, which crashed every test that touched a battle (detail, interlinks, playback, atlas, copy). Fixed to a real .find() lookup. This alone explains a large share of the 126.

attempt5Fixes.Questions entry (learning.spec.ts:157): TEST bug, not a view bug: questions[] entities have `prompt`, but the marker lookup only tried title/name/historicalName/text -> empty string -> assertion failed on all 6 projects. attempt5Fixes.raw enum leak (learning.spec.ts:817): The old assertion checked the whole innerText for "interpretation"/"claimType". That is a CONTENT defect, handed back, not a UI defect. The test now asserts the actual requirement: every [data-claim-type] element renders a Chinese label and never the bare English enum.
